1.source_text: Behold, I say unto you, my son, that because you did not translate according to that which you desired' of me, and did commence again to write for my servant Joseph Smith, Jun., even so I would that you should continue until you have finished this record, which I have entrusted unto him ; and then, behold, other records have I that I will give unto you power that you may assist to translate.
